Watch the birds — when they go quiet, the pack is already moving." "The pack circles — nips from the edge, never committing." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ella mutters "And you're still standing." Aria asks "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
